The Opportunity

Independent cinemas are invisible to national advertisers. Together, they are not.

Problem 01

Too small to buy alone

Agencies plan national campaigns. A four-hall cinema in Segamat or Tawau rarely makes it onto the media plan, however full its halls are.

ResultLeft off national media plans
Problem 02

Every operator sells alone

No shared rate card, no shared booking, no common proof of play. Advertisers would need to deal with a dozen operators to reach the same audience.

ResultToo complex for advertisers to buy
Problem 03

Pre-show time goes unsold

The minutes before the feature are filled with house trailers, or nothing at all, instead of earning revenue every session.

ResultRevenue left on the table, every show
The AdSmart answer

Pool every independent screen into one network.

  • One booking reaches 50+ locations
  • One creative, one QC check
  • One invoice and one proof of play report
  • Revenue shared back to each cinema

Deployment

Two ways to use AdSmart.

The same platform serves a pooled network of independents, or a single large chain selling its own screens.

Model A · Independent Network

Many operators, one reach

Independent cinemas join one shared AdSmart network. Advertisers and agencies book the whole network, a region, or a targeted audience.

  • Shared rate card and national sales channel
  • Each cinema keeps its own brand and operations
  • Revenue split per outlet: 60% cinema, 40% AdSmart
  • Cinema's own trailers and content still play
Model B · Chain Edition

One chain, its own platform

A large chain runs AdSmart for its own advertising sales, across its own sites, with its own team approving and billing.

  • Private rate card and advertiser accounts
  • In-house QC and approval workflow
  • Automated invoicing and proof of play
  • Smart Targeting on its own POS membership data

How It Works

From upload to proof of play, on one platform.

Steps 1 to 3 happen entirely inside AdSmart. Steps 4 and 5 run automatically.

01
Upload the campaignAdvertiser or agency uploads the DCP creative with its LPF certificate, then picks dates, locations, genres or an audience.
Advertiser
02
Quality checkQC Officer checks audio, picture, duration and edit rate, the LPF certificate and the ad category.
QC Officer
03
Final approvalAdministrator finalises the slots and approves. Rejections always carry a note back to the advertiser.
Administrator
04
Delivered and playedAdSmart instructs each exhibitor's NOC. Show playlists are built and pushed to every TMS automatically.
Automatic
05
Billed and reportedAdvertiser gets the invoice, proof of play and audience reach. Each cinema gets its revenue statement.
Automatic
No booth operator. No USB drives. No spreadsheets.Every play is logged by SpotLight TMS and reconciled in AdSmart.

Compliance · Tax & Invoicing

AdSmart bills the advertiser, so AdSmart carries the tax duties.

Money flow · one RM 1,000 booking
Advertiser pays RM 1,080RM 1,000 booking + 8% SST, on a validated MyInvois e-invoice
AdSmart remits RM 80 SSTTo RMCD, on the full booking value
RM 600Cinema, via self-billed e-invoice
RM 400AdSmart, taxed as profit
SST registration

8% Service Tax, RMCD

Register once 12-month taxable turnover passes RM 500,000. Advertising and digital platform services are taxable.

Principal, not agent

SST on the full booking

Because AdSmart collects payment and invoices advertisers, it is treated as the service provider, not just on its 40%.

E-invoicing, LHDN

MyInvois both ways

Validated e-invoices to advertisers. Self-billed e-invoices record each cinema's revenue share.

Corporate income tax

On net commission

15% to 17% on the first RM 600,000 for qualifying SMEs, 24% thereafter. SToDS and withholding tax apply only to foreign operators.

Summary for planning only, not tax advice. Confirm the structure with a licensed tax adviser before launch.
00 / 00 · Tax & Invoicing
Compliance · Content & Law

Compliance enforced in the workflow, not left to chance.

Act 620 · LPF

Film Censorship Act 2002

Every cinema ad needs an LPF certificate from the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Upload of the LPF certificate is mandatory before go-live.
Act 244 · FINAS

Licensing roles

Cinemas hold their exhibition licences. Advertising filmlets fall under film distribution and exhibition rules.

Contracts define AdSmart as a booking intermediary, not an exhibitor.
Advertising code

Category rules

Not accepted: tobacco and vapes, gambling, alcohol, pork products, occult services, sexual content.

Health, pharma and finance ads need ministry approval, e.g. KKLIU.
PDPA 2010

Personal data

Advertiser contacts, billing data and audience analytics all need notice, consent and security.

Smart Targeting uses consented, aggregated data only.
QC gate: no LPF certificate or category clearance, no approval. The campaign cannot reach a screen.
